name: Nigerian Dodo (Fried Ripe Plantain)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup puréed chile pepper mixed with tomatoes

steps: Cut each ripe plantain into 6 small pieces. Toss with salt and chile-tomato purée to taste.
Heat ½ cup of oil in a frying pan. Add the 6 plantain pieces, and deep fry until all sides are golden brown.
Serve with jollof rice or bean porridge.
